items.text: Your AI Slop Bores Me lets players role-play a human chatbot, answering other users’ questions while parodying formulaic AI responses.
items.text_zh: “Your AI Slop Bores Me”让玩家扮演真人聊天机器人，回答其他用户的问题，以此戏仿套路化的 AI 回复。

items.text: Cloudflare Computer gives AI agents persistent, isolated environments that can retain files and processes while running long-lived tasks.
items.text_zh: Cloudflare Computer 为 AI 智能体提供可持久保存文件和进程的隔离环境，用于执行长时间任务。

items.text: A woman alleged that her stepfather used Grok to turn her childhood photograph into explicit imagery, highlighting generative-image abuse risks.
items.text_zh: 一名女子称继父使用 Grok 将她的童年照片改成露骨图像，再次凸显生成式图像的滥用风险。

items.text: Google AI Studio invited developers to share weekend vibe-coding projects, reflecting continued community promotion of prompt-driven application building.
items.text_zh: Google AI Studio 邀请开发者分享周末“氛围编程”项目，继续推动以提示词驱动的应用开发方式。

items.text: GitHub demonstrated creating a custom-domain Pages site with HTTPS in roughly 14 minutes without manually editing DNS records.
items.text_zh: GitHub 演示了如何在约 14 分钟内创建使用自定义域名和 HTTPS 的 Pages 网站，全程无需手动修改 DNS 记录。

items.text: An essay argued that AI systems possess vastly more working memory than humans, helping explain their advantage on some mathematical tasks.
items.text_zh: 一篇文章认为，AI 系统拥有远超人类的工作记忆容量，这有助于解释其在部分数学任务上的优势。

items.text: GitHub spotlighted debate over whether open-source agent platform OpenClaw could become an AI-era equivalent of Linux.
items.text_zh: GitHub 聚焦了一场讨论：开源智能体平台 OpenClaw 是否可能成为 AI 时代的 Linux。

items.text: A Google Developer Expert built a vision agent that transforms live webcam selfies into generative artwork.
items.text_zh: 一位 Google 开发者专家构建了视觉智能体，可将摄像头中的实时自拍转换为生成式艺术作品。

items.text: Astro’s creator introduced Flue, a React-inspired meta-harness using hooks to compose and manage AI-agent behavior.
items.text_zh: Astro 创始人推出 Flue：一种借鉴 React、通过 Hooks 组合和管理 AI 智能体行为的元框架。

items.text: Databricks shared DevHub prompts that help coding agents inspect environments and set up Databricks Apps from natural-language instructions.
items.text_zh: Databricks 分享了 DevHub 提示词，帮助编程智能体检查环境，并通过自然语言指令配置 Databricks Apps。

items.text: The Decoder reported investor pressure was pushing Nvidia to reduce its planned OpenAI investment as Anthropic’s financial performance strengthened.
items.text_zh: The Decoder 报道称，在 Anthropic 财务表现走强之际，投资者压力正促使英伟达缩减原计划对 OpenAI 的投资。

items.text: PixVerse highlighted a user-made AI video whose emotional performance was presented as an intentional directing choice rather than incidental model output.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 展示了一段用户制作的 AI 视频，并称其中的情绪表现源于有意的导演选择，而非模型的偶然输出。

items.text: MarkTechPost published a practical guide to fine-tuning tool-calling language models using XYZ-Aquila-SFT and Qwen3.
items.text_zh: MarkTechPost 发布实用指南，介绍如何使用 XYZ-Aquila-SFT 与 Qwen3 微调具备工具调用能力的语言模型。

items.text: AI-generated books are flooding Amazon’s marketplace, increasing discoverability problems and depressing sales for some human authors, The Decoder reported.
items.text_zh: The Decoder 报道称，AI 生成书籍大量涌入亚马逊，令作品更难被发现，并压低部分人类作者的销量。
